Name: Joja Berries
Author: BasiliskL
Description:
Joja had a research lab working on making the Ultimate berry using the sweet gem berry as a base but an accident caused the lab to be destroyed in a huge explosion. Reports claim that there had been explosion sounds from the lab for weeks before the accident but had been told that everything was under control. Joja thought all their work had been destroyed but was it?


The seeds aren't able to be purchased and instead you must find the first 10 berry variants in the wild with bushes having a low chance of having a berry. Unfortunately with how much genetic manipulation Joja did the seed maker can't normally make a seed so you'll need 1 of each of the 10 berries you can find to make a single material that you can then use with mixed seeds to make a seed in the seed maker but it can grow in all seasons, including winter, and although it takes a long time to grow it will continue producing. Though the plants can end up mutating together at times (giant crop) and then need to be replanted.

100 Joja Berry variants but currently most just have a placeholder image
Currently making artisanal goods

Artisanal goods will be long processing times but high selling price, some will be better than starfruit/ancient fruit products
Quality of berry used will depend on the variant number:
00-09: directly pass to the artisanal goods
10-89: increase output
90-99: both

Highly recommend using the better chests mod with this and changing the config of better chests to have junimo huts have infinite inventory space and that be how you harvest cause there's gonna be a lot of drops per plant and it might cause lag since there could end up being a lot of items on the ground
Alternatively instead of junimo huts the deluxe grabber redux mod would also work with the MYC patch but still need to change it to infinite inventory space

Downloads.Description:
Use this only if you want to break your economy as both the sell prices and health and stamina restoring are much higher than vanilla crops


Just drag the included [JA] Joja Berries folder into the Joja Berries mod folder to overwrite the object files
